The next time you take an Uber, there is a strong possibility that you are being video-recorded inside the cab. If your first thought is that a driver—or perhaps a driver who also creates content—might be doing this, that is not the case at all; it is Uber itself that is carrying out the recording. In fact, the ride-sharing and cab-booking platform has introduced encrypted trip video recording. Uber has enabled this feature for its approximately 2 million driver-partners in India to help resolve disputes.
